dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual narrowing from a broad mid-body to a highly constricted, elongated posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Asymmetrical lateral margins; the left margin exhibits a pronounced convex bulge followed by a deep concave narrowing toward the peduncle, while the right margin maintains a more uniform convex curve.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; uniform high-intensity pixel distribution across the visible dorsal plane.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A sharp, distinct vertical crease or shadow-casting fold along the posterior dorsal midline extending toward the peduncle.
